Title.Repeal: Interpretation of Part VII and supplementary provisions.

Text.Repeal: In this Part of this Act, unless the context otherwise requires—

Repeal.Substitution: ” has the same meaning as in Part I of the Local Government Finance Act 1992;

Text.Repeal: ” means a person under the age of 16;

Repeal.Addition: two people who are married to, or civil partners of, each other and are members of the same household; or
two people who are not married to, or civil partners of, each other but are living together

Addition.Substitution: as if they were a married couple or civil partners

Text.Repeal: ” means any residential accommodation, whether or not consisting of the whole or part of a building and whether or not comprising separate and self-contained premises;
” means—

and a member of the same household for whom that person is responsible and who is a child or a person of a prescribed description;

Repeal.Addition: ” has the same meaning as in the Jobseekers Act 1995;

Text.Repeal: ” means a scheme made under Schedule 8 to this Act or section 159 of the 1975 Act or under the Old Cases Act;

Repeal.Addition: ” in relation to Scotland means a council constituted under section 2 of the Local Government
” has the meaning given by the rules in paragraph 1 of Schedule 4 to the Pensions Act 1995 (c. 26);

Text.Repeal: ”means specified in or determined in accordance with regulations;

Repeal.Addition: the qualifying age for state pension credit
” is (in accordance with section 1(2)(b) and (6) of the State Pension Credit Act 2002)—
in the case of a woman, pensionable age; or
in the case of a man, the age which is pensionable age in the case of a woman born on the same day as the man;
” means state pension credit under the State Pension Credit Act 2002;

Text.Repeal: ” means a scheme under which war pensions (as defined in section 25 of the
Social Security Act 1989) are provided;
”, in relation to
, means a period of 7 days beginning with a Monday.
Regulations may make provision for the purposes of this Part of this Act—
as to circumstances in which a person is to be treated as being or not being in Great Britain;
continuing a person’s entitlement to benefit during periods of temporary absence from Great Britain;
as to what is or is not to be treated as remunerative work or as employment;

Repeal.Substitution: as to circumstances in which a person is or is not to be treated as engaged or normally engaged in remunerative work;

Text.Repeal: as to what is or is not to be treated as relevant education;
as to circumstances in which a person is or is not to be treated as receiving relevant education;
specifying the descriptions of pension increases under war pension schemes or industrial injuries schemes that are analogous to the benefits mentioned in section 129(2)(b)(i) to (iii) above;
as to circumstances in which a person is or is not to be treated as occupying a dwelling as his home;
for treating any person who is liable to make payments in respect of a dwelling as if he were not so liable;
for treating any person who is not liable to make payments in respect of a dwelling as if he were so liable;
for treating as included in a dwelling any land used for the purposes of the dwelling;
as to circumstances in which persons are to be treated as being or not being members of the same household;
as to circumstances in which one person is to be treated as responsible or not responsible for another.
